synth.notes:
Vertical A1/A2: ring+beam y-/+6, carry on-beam blocks, push hit blocks in a chain; cancel the whole move if any block y leaves [2,58].
Horizontal A4/A3: beam w+/-6 in [1,43]; hooked (next/collected block at x==beam.x+w-5) drags all on-beam blocks, unhooked extend pushes swept blocks.
Blocked group (x>48 or into ring) -> blocks stay, beam changes alone (step 128: hooked collected block_12 drags block_9 past 48, beam extends alone).
Tags: hooked next whose other on-beam blocks are all collected -> collected, rightmost todo -> next; collected block off beam -> next (old next -> todo).
No global counter: the A3 x/no_change/tags split is hooked vs unhooked vs ring-blocked. Unconfirmed: collection order beyond rightmost-todo; clicks/A5/A7 treated as no-ops.
